properties.w: The Songhai Empire fell to Morocco in 1591. This area was then split between the Moroccan Pashalik of Timbuktu and smaller successor states; the source keeps the old outline.
Ainu land. The Matsumae domain held only the southern tip and a few trading posts; Japan took direct control of Ezo (Hokkaido) from 1799.

properties.n: Patagonian shellfish and marine mammal hunters

properties.w: No country owned Svalbard until the 1920 Svalbard Treaty. The source drew it inside Norway.
